message: Version 0.5.6 is the stable-signing upgrade proof release that verifies v0.5.5 can upgrade to v0.5.6 without reinstalling.
releaseNotes: Stable-signing upgrade proof: this release uses the same stable debug keystore introduced for the clean v0.5.5 baseline and publishes a v0.5.6 APK artifact for public update-feed release testing. The expected result is a normal Android install over v0.5.5 with no signing mismatch.
